name: Kite-native liquid NSE EQ cross-sectional continuation experiment
universe_definition: Top-N currently tradable NSE EQ instruments ranked by median daily traded value during a pre-strategy formation window.
formation_rule: Use only 5-minute OHLCV from the frozen formation window. Daily traded value is sum(close * volume) across 5-minute bars; rank by median daily traded value; select top-N before any Strategy 001J outcome is evaluated.
survivorship_bias_policy: Current Kite instrument availability does not reconstruct historical delistings or historical index membership. This tactical universe is therefore not PIT-clean and is not eligible for final promotion without explicit treatment of that limitation.
deferred_clean_universe: PIT Nifty 100 remains a separate deferred acquisition path if historical membership data becomes available.
selection_rule: Development data only; candidate frozen before chronological holdout and prospective testing.
next_action: Fetch the broker-native formation window, build the registered U1 universe, fetch full research-window data for selected symbols, then run the data gates and frozen-001D baseline.
